user_problem: FAQ answers need to be useful while staying inside supplied policy, product, and exception boundaries.
unique_output: A set of answer frames with direct response, supported detail, exception, unknown case, and escalation wording.
required_input: Questions, approved facts, policy clauses, exceptions, prohibited promises, and named escalation destination.
critical_rule: Never fill policy gaps with common practice; unknown cases must be stated and routed using supplied instructions.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is customer-support-replies; this builds reusable bounded FAQ entries rather than responding to individual customers.
acceptance_scenario: Input says returns allowed within 30 days for unused goods; opened software excluded; damaged-item rule absent; contact is Support Desk. Output answers the standard and software cases and routes damaged items without inventing eligibility.
